answers.body: Illustrative guidance for this demo: check the invitation and on-screen instructions rather than assuming every employer uses the same timings. Use preparation time for a few bullet prompts: the point you want to make, your personal contribution and the outcome. Practise explaining it naturally, then review whether you answered the question.
Fictional student reply: I found it more useful to practise one example and review the recording than to memorise a whole script.
